Welcome to Sycamore Avenue Treehouses & Cottages
Dinner, Bed and Breakfast Accommodation.
For Rates and Availability click BOOK NOW Button below.
Eccentric, Unique and Romantic Treehouse  Accommodation on the Kwa- Zulu Natal Midlands Meander.
Our artistically designed Treehouses will inspire and encourage you to relax, unwind and relive your childhood fantasies. Come and enjoy yourself by either soaking in a private Spa-Bath, warming yourself by a cozy fire or indulging in a glass of wine on the patio whilst watching the sunset over Giants Castle in the Drakensberg.
If we can t fly with birds we can at least nest with them.

From PMB/Durban

pages.text:
Romantic Treehouse | Sycamore Avenue
Romantic Treehouse
This is our smallest and quirkiest Treehouse, built onto a tree whose generous branches provide a leafy retreat from the summer Sun. Come relax on the high platform in a hammock while catching the sunset views of the Drakensberg. For the cooler times, there is a fireplace inside that supplies warmth and good cheer or simply indulge yourselves in the private Spa Bath.
This Treehouse is a favourite among our Honeymooners.

pages.text:
Fantasy Treehouse | Sycamore Avenue
Fantasy Treehouse
Fantasy is a three level Treehouse with two bedrooms each with a bathroom on separate levels, thus being a four sleeper. The top bedroom has a glassed shower in it with a separate toilet. The ground level is a sitting room with fireplace, which also boasts a large wooden chess set. An aerial walkway leads you to your separate, private Spa Bath (the Spa in the Sky)

Bottle Treehouse | Sycamore Avenue
Bottle Treehouse
A charming cladded Treehouse with a bottle theme that has a queen‐sized bed and Spa-Bath in the bedroom. Leading off the main room, is a patio deck with hammocks, an outdoor shower and views of the Berg.
